title: Why Yu Yu Hakusho Could Benefit From a Modern Anime Remake
excerpt:
A new opinion piece argues that the classic deserves a fresh adaptation.
No new Yu Yu Hakusho anime reboot has been officially announced.
body_md:
Yu Yu Hakusho, based on Yoshihiro Togashi's manga, began its original 112-episode anime run in 1992. It follows Yusuke Urameshi, a teenager who dies while saving a child and is given another chance as a Spirit Detective investigating supernatural threats.

An opinion article argues that recent successful revivals of older anime, including Ranma 1/2 and Urusei Yatsura, make a strong case for revisiting the series with contemporary animation and a fuller adaptation of its 19 manga volumes.

Studios such as MAPPA, Bones, Wit and Madhouse are mentioned only as hypothetical candidates. The article also points to the 2011 Hunter x Hunter adaptation as a useful comparison. No studio selection, production start or release date for a new Yu Yu Hakusho anime has been confirmed.
